title: Structured character currency (wallet) and money flows
description:
Money is not modeled today: the CharacterSheet carries only prose equipment (equipment: string[]); neither the live character table nor any wallet represents coin. Add a structured, rules-pack-bound wallet to the canonical CharacterSheet plus deterministic money mutations.

Currency considerations:
- It is CONTINUITY state and travels with the character under custody (ADR 0012) — not campaign-local unless a campaign explicitly banks/confiscates/converts it.
- It is distinct from inventory item rows: a wallet, not items. Reconcile the boundary between the wallet, the inventory table, and the sheet's prose equipment.
- Leveling (XP/level/HP/features/slots) does not need currency, but treasure/quest REWARD flows do; the wallet should exist before reward flows. This epic can proceed in parallel with the progression beads.
- Coinage is rules-pack-bound (5e cp/sp/ep/gp/pp differs from other systems); it lives behind the pack like the rest of the sheet.
acceptance_criteria:
- A structured wallet (e.g. {cp,sp,ep,gp,pp} for 5e) lives on the canonical CharacterSheet, rules-pack-bound.
- Deterministic gain/spend/convert mutations exist and are auditable.
- The wallet travels with the character under custody and is not silently campaign-local.
- The boundary between wallet, inventory rows, and prose equipment is defined.
- CLI/session can view and adjust currency.
